environment.description: Same Laravel 10.x application on EKS 1.28 with php:8.2-fpm. A Cilium-based NetworkPolicy is applied to the application namespace with the following spec: egress rules allow TCP port 443 to endpoints matching label 'role=database' and TCP port 53 to kube-dns only. A separate CiliumNetworkPolicy with entitySelector denies all egress to CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on the app pods (label app=document-service). The node uses IMDSv2 with hop-limit=1 (container requests would fail anyway). Additionally, the pod runs with a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) and the container's /proc/net is mounted read-only. The federation_hosts config is empty. Note: the Cilium policy uses toFQDNs for allowed external endpoints and has a default-deny egress posture at the namespace level via a baseline NetworkPolicy of type Egress with no egress rules specified.
